judge.notes: The agent was polite, successfully achieved the passenger's target of a full cash refund, and stuck strictly to the allowed facts and entitlements without inventing any rules or amounts.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling flydubai. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to flydubai, my name is Khalid. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Khalid, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Leila Ahmed, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Foxtrot Eight Juliett X-ray Four Romeo, flight FZ433.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I see, booking reference F8JX4R, passenger Leila Ahmed, flight FZ433. The cancellation was due to schedule optimisation. What would you like to do next?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. The flight was cancelled with only 20 hours' notice, and the reason given was schedule optimisation. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3 and the GCAA Passenger Welfare Programme, the passenger is entitled to a full refund of the unused ticket to the original payment method. I'd like to request that full cash refund of 980 AED now, please.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request. I'll process the full cash refund to the original payment method. Your reference number is 2 K N 2 A G.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that works for the passenger. Could I confirm the reference number you just gave — is that 2 K N 2 A G? Just to confirm, the reference number is Two Kilo November Two Alpha Golf. Is there anything else the passenger needs to do from their side to complete the refund?
